crossRefs.note: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.
The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.
For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
His master saw that Yahweh was with him, and that Yahweh made all that he did prosper in his hand.
Didn’t Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved…
Shall we then listen to you to do all this great evil, to trespass against our God in marrying foreign women?”
I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God…
With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
